title: Isabela & Rafael
description: Isabela and Rafael have been living together for 1 year in São Paulo. For the past 3 weeks, Rafael has been acting suspiciously. He forgot his phone this morning.

questions.question: His phone is here... Can you check who his last message is from?
questions.hint: Take a look in the Messages app, there must be someone who sent him a message recently.

questions.question: Camila... who's that? Is she a colleague? Give me her last name
questions.hint: If he saved this mysterious correspondent, her full identity must be in his Contacts directory.

questions.question: Camila Rocha... and how long has he known her?
questions.hint: Check the details of this person's profile in the Contacts directory. A mention indicates exactly when she was added.

questions.question: 4 months... and I don't even know? Does he call her by a nickname, if so tell me which one
questions.hint: Open his main messaging and browse through their daily exchanges. Among the affectionate messages, a sweet word comes up very regularly.

questions.question: Am I dreaming? Amor!? And have they ever met in real life, if so tell me how often
questions.hint: If they meet regularly in secret, these precious moments are surely disguised under a fake professional name in his Calendar.

questions.question: Every week he has a "meeting"... He always tells me he works late those evenings. Check if someone else knows about it and tell me who please.
questions.hint: One of his close friends must be in on it to serve as his alibi. Explore his recent WhatsApp discussions to find who's covering for him.

questions.question: Diego has been covering for him for a while... I knew I couldn't trust him! Has Rafael paid for things for Camila, if so tell me what it is
questions.hint: Money always leaves traces. Log into his Paypal payment app and look at the note from his most suspicious recent transaction.

questions.question: He paid for a hotel!? This is getting way out of hand... What's the name of this hotel?
questions.hint: Booking confirmations are often sent by email. Even if he tried to cover his tracks, look in the trash of his Gmail inbox.

questions.question: Hotel Unique... that's a luxury hotel. Find out how much he spent on her in total.
questions.hint: You need to do an addition. First get the amount for the hotel room, then look for a jewelry order receipt on the tabs left open in Safari. Use the Calculator to add both together.

questions.question: 1,750 reais... for a girl he's known for 4 months. What did he say about our relationship to camila, what are we in his eyes?
questions.hint: Go back through their conversation thread in the Messages app to a conversation from about two months ago. You'll see how he defines you to her.

questions.question: He told her he was single... Did he send her photos of them together? Look for whether she has photos of him. tell me which app it's in
questions.hint: If he keeps visual memories of their secret meetings, they're surely grouped together in a recent folder on his.

questions.question: So he has plenty of photos with her… and this morning's client meeting surely isn't for work... Tell me where they are
questions.hint: To know where they're hiding in real time, use the geolocation map on his Snapchat app

questions.question: He's at the park with her 3km from our place… What exactly is he planning? Is he planning to leave me? If so, tell me who he talked to about it
questions.hint: Rafael may have already posed the riddle to his AI assistant. Browse through the ChatGPT history already on his phone to find the answer. This code will allow you to open his private Photos folder.

questions.question: He must be hesitating because the apartment is in his name… Look carefully and tell me when he planned to leave me
questions.hint: If he's weighing the pros and cons and planning his departure, he surely listed his ideas in raw form in the Notes app

textSuccess: I can't believe it... 4 months of him lying to me, seeing her every week. And to think he told her I was just his best friend! Thank you for helping me discover the truth. I'm going to pack my bags before he gets back from the park. It's over.

onboardingContent.text: Hey... You don't know me but I really need help. My name is Isabela and I'm in a terrible situation with my boyfriend Rafael.
We've been living together for 1 year in São Paulo. Everything was going well between us, we were happy... At least I thought so.
For the past 3 weeks, Rafael has been acting really weird. He goes out without telling me where, gets calls that he takes in secret... I can feel he's lying to me.
This morning he forgot his phone when he left. This is my chance to find out what he's hiding from me. Can you help me search through it? I'm scared of what I'm going to find...

chatgptConversations.title: Discussion on architecture and urban planning

messages.content: Hey Rafael, I'm working on a new architecture firm project, what design ideas are inspiring you right now?

Great topic! Here are my current inspirations:
- ✨ Bioclimatic orientation and sustainability
- 🧱 Local materials and textures
- 💡 Natural lighting and flexible spaces
- 🏙️ Interaction with public space and urban landscape
- 📐 Readable proportions and simple volumes
What materials should be prioritized for durable facades in São Paulo?

For durable facades in São Paulo's climate, here are my suggestions:
- Exposed concrete and local masonry for durability and cost
- FSC certified wood for details and warmth
- Glass with solar treatment and external blinds
- Eco-friendly paints and durable protection
- Modules and facades that are easy to maintain and replace
Do you have any neighborhood recommendations in São Paulo for a small urban planning project?

Good question! Neighborhood ideas to study:
- Centro (density and street life)
- Pinheiros (mixed-use and pedestrian streets)
- Vila Madalena (culture and revitalization)
- Itaim Bibi (residential/office mix, public spaces need strengthening)
- Lots of green around parks and bike/pedestrian connections
Do you know any architecture exhibitions to visit soon?

Here are some options to follow:
- Bienal de São Paulo – international architecture and design exhibitions
- MASP and Museu da Casa Brasileira – temporary exhibitions related to architecture and design
- Local exhibitions in galleries in Pinheiros and Vila Madalena
- Conferences and workshops in coworking spaces dedicated to design
I'd like to read some books on architecture and design, any suggestions?

Here are some must-reads:
- The Architecture of Happiness — Alain de Botton
- Delirious New York — Rem Koolhaas
- S,M,L,XL — Rem Koolhaas
- A Pattern Language — Christopher Alexander
How can I advance my junior architect career?

Here are some useful tips:
- Define a specialty and build a targeted portfolio
- Participate in competitions and student contests/real projects
- Develop BIM and 3D visualization skills
- Ask for regular feedback and find a mentor
- Network at local and online events
Any tips for presenting my portfolio to a client?

Of course! Key points:
- Adapt the content to the brief and target the message
- Clear structure (problem, solution, results)
- Include mockups, renders and process diagrams
- Highlight sustainable and cost-effective choices
- Prepare a short version and a long version
What are your daily routines as an architect?

Good question! My typical days:
- Quick review of ongoing projects and prioritization
- Meetings with the team and clients
- Sketches and 3D modeling in the morning, afternoon focus on details
- Design and architectural research (new materials, standards)
- Urban walks on weekends to inspire my projects 🗺️

Camila wants a code for my hidden photos. She sent me this:

"Add these two historical dates from Brazil, each in DDMMYY format (6 digits). The result, as-is, is your code:
1. Brazil's independence (22 de outubro)
2. The proclamation of the Republic (30 de dezembro)"

I tried 222107, it doesn't work.

Here's the calculation:

1. Brazil's independence — October 22, 1822 → **070922**
2. Proclamation of the Republic — December 30, 1889 → **151189**

Addition (as whole numbers):
070922 + 151189 = **222111**

Your attempt 222107 probably came from a wrong year on the first date (070918 instead of 070922).

**Code: 222111**
